content: The D23 event's "Deep Dive into Kingdom Hearts " panel presented an extended four-minute trailer for the Kingdom Hearts IV game on Saturday. title: Manga 'Game Center Shoujo to Ibunka Kouryuu' Ends With 12th Volume
content: The official X account for author Hirokazu Yasuhara announced on Saturday that the Game Center Shoujo to Ibunka Kouryuu ( Cultural Exchange With Game Center Girl ) manga is ending with the 12th volume, following the publication of its 153rd and final chapter.
author: MyAnimeList

title: My Hero Academia’s Zeno Robinson Talks Series Finale, Hawks’ Future (Exclusive)
content: My Hero Academia has finally come to an end, with Studio BONES not just satisfied with releasing the original series finale, but also creating epilogue specials to help fully flesh out the shonen superhero universe.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix Is Adding One of the Best Psychological Anime Movies Ever Made
content: Netflix is setting up its September 2026 lineup, and it already has some exciting updates for fans. Over the years, the streaming giant has been expanding its anime library with some intriguing originals and all-time classics.

content: Real-world anime exhibitions are nothing new for Japan, with a handful of them making their way to North America thanks to installations, conventions, and more. title: Plott' Announces Rakuraku Hanten Short Anime for September
content: YouTube anime production and distribution company Plott announced on Saturday a new short anime Rakuraku Hanten will launch on YouTube in late September. Masaru Yoshimura plays Sia. Tsubasa Sasa plays Paoran. Takuya Masamoto plays Gao. Chikahiro Kobayashi plays Lay. Ran Koba plays Chaomi. Tomokazu Seki plays Mugoku.
author: ANN

title: Anime Removed by Crunchyroll Hits New Milestone
content: Crunchyroll is routinely thought of by many as the “anime streaming service,” with the platform routinely being the exclusive platform for many franchises that make their way from Japan to the United States. Unfortunately, this prestigious title doesn’t mean that Crunchyroll is able to entirely avoid drama.

title: Chainsaw Man’s Denji Voice Actor, Ryan Colt Levy, Talks Manga’s Controversial Ending (Exclusive)
content: Earlier in 2026, mangaka Tatsuki Fujimoto brought Denji’s story to a close as the Chainsaw Man manga released its final chapter. With the bloody shonen franchise throwing a massive curveball at the Chainsaw Devil, many fans are still attempting to wrap their heads around how the protagonist saw his life end up.

title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 Features Rukia Kuchiki Changes in Episode 4 Ending Video
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 The Calamity premiered Episode 4 on August 9 with new changes to its ending video. While the majority of the video is unchanged, there are several frames that now feature Rukia Kuchiki.
